summary: Anyone have problems with mediawiki TinyMCE plugin after latest update to mediawiki? Had to set plugin not to load in order to stop throwing a load balance error. Giving up on visual editors, people need to learn a bit of media markup. #wikimedia
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Anyone have problems with mediawiki TinyMCE plugin after latest update to mediawiki? Had to set plugin not to load in order to stop throwing a load balance error. Giving up on visual editors, people need to learn a bit of media markup. #wikimedia
